text.p: Police said Tuesday they have found no trace of five young people who disappeared four days ago driving an off-road vehicle.
Snow and poor visibility hampered search efforts but volunteers joined police and sheriff's deputies again Tuesday looking at lakes and waterways in case the vehicle broke through ice and sank.

Missing were three students at St. Mary's College -- Mary Karnick, Darien, Illinois, Anne Locher, Plymouth, Minnesota and Susan Wall, Chicago -- and two recent graduates of the school, Timothy Stapleton, Chaska, Minnesota, and Jason Collins, Duluth, Minnesota.

The five were last seen at a bar early Saturday morning. The utility vehicle in which they were last seen was capable of off-road travel, leading police to believe they may have headed into hilly areas near this town on the Mississippi River 100 miles southwest of Mineapolis-St. Paul.
